tasks.title: Fix stale-task evict race in CaptureTaskRegistry.discard
tasks.problem: discard() pops whatever is registered for (user_id, thread_id) with no identity check. Race: cancel() pops+cancels stale task A, handler registers new task B for the same topic, then A's finally: discard() (message_handlers.py:256) evicts B from the registry - clear_topic_state (cleanup.py:39) can no longer cancel B, leaking a live capture watcher. Same window exists on natural 30s timeout vs concurrent register. Pre-existing race (ISS-010 residual debt).
tasks.solution: Identity-checked discard: discard(user_id, thread_id, task=None) pops only when the registered entry IS the finishing task; self-cleanup call site passes asyncio.current_task(); regression test: stale discard does not evict newer registration; legacy discard without task keeps popping (backward compat).
acceptance_criteria: discard with mismatched task identity is a no-op
capture_bash_output finally passes its own task (asyncio.current_task())
regression test: cancel(A) -> register(B) -> discard(A) leaves B registered; discard(B) clears
existing capture-registry tests stay green; suite green; pyright 0
tasks.resolution: Identity-checked discard: discard(user_id, thread_id, task=None) pops only when registered entry IS the finishing task; capture_bash_output finally passes asyncio.current_task(); +2 regression tests (stale-evict, matching-remove) appended to tests/ccbot/test_capture_registry.py (existing 4 untouched).
